req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies pagination functionality using 'skip' and 'limit' parameters. Tests should cover normal operation, boundary conditions, and error handling to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_pagination_positive_case
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=5 and limit=5
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure at least 10 tasks exist
for i in range(10):
    client.post('/tasks/', json={
        'title': f'Task {i}',
        'description': f'Description {i}',
        'completed': False
    })

# Action: Request tasks with skip=5 and limit=5
response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=5&limit=5')

# Expected: HTTP 200 and 5 tasks returned
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 5

tests.name: test_pagination_negative_case_invalid_skip
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=-1 and limit=5
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Request tasks with invalid skip=-1
response = client.get('/tasks/?skip=-1&limit=5')

# Expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity

tests.name: test_pagination_boundary_case_limit
actions: Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=100
Send GET request to /tasks/ with skip=0 and limit=101
expected: First request: HTTP 200 response, 100 tasks returned
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Ensure at least 101 tasks exist
for i in range(101):
    client.post('/tasks/', json={
        'title': f'Task {i}',
        'description': f'Description {i}',
        'completed': False
    })

# Action: Request tasks with limit=100
response_100 = client.get('/tasks/?skip=0&limit=100')

# Expected: HTTP 200 and 100 tasks returned
assert response_100.status_code == 200
assert len(response_100.json()) == 100

# Action: Request tasks with limit=101
response_101 = client.get('/tasks/?skip=0&limit=101')

# Expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity
assert response_101.status_code == 422
